summary: P2 feature testing: Chakra Cleansing (13 unique images), Elemental Temples API migration, Water Practices API migration. All 28 backend tests passed. All 3 frontend pages verified via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: WaterPractices.jsx has a declared `loading` state that is set but never renders a loading spinner/placeholder — practices are just empty until API resolves. Minor UX gap but not blocking.
ElementalTemples.jsx is 1263 lines (over 700-line threshold) — contains full STATIC_ELEMENTS fallback AND API fetch logic. Consider splitting static data to a separate file.

WaterPractices.jsx depends on `api` prop passed from App.js Route render callback — if api prop is ever null, the useEffect bails silently and practices never load. This is safe because ChakraCleansing.jsx uses its own axios instance instead — the two patterns are inconsistent across pages.
seed_data_creation: None - data already seeded via server.py startup
context_for_next_testing_agent: P2 features fully working. All 13 chakra images are unique (verified via Playwright and backend tests). Elemental Temples loads 5 elements from MongoDB with full content (practices, rituals, ceremonies, blessings, affirmations). Water Practices loads 19 practices across 7 categories from MongoDB. Earth temple detail view shows all section tabs. Water practice modal shows steps, materials, affirmation. Previous carry-over issue from iteration_44: HeartPractices.jsx guided mode field name mismatch (steps vs ceremony_steps/etc) - still unresolved.
